stories.title: "L'Ukraine doit avoir un nouveau président": Donald Trump appelle à remplacer Volodymr Zelensky

en.title: "Ukraine must have a new president": Donald Trump calls for replacing Volodymyr Zelensky
en.summary: Donald Trump criticized Volodymyr Zelensky, stating it was time for Ukraine to have a new president. He urged Zelensky to stop striking Russian oil refineries following a diesel agreement reached with Moscow.

stories.title: Lula accuse Meta d'"interférences" dans la campagne présidentielle

en.title: Lula accuses Meta of "interference" in presidential campaign
en.summary: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's campaign team accused Meta of interfering in his reelection bid through alleged blocking of his content on Facebook, WhatsApp, and Instagram.

stories.title: Le "petfluencing" séduit les réseaux sociaux, mais inquiète les défenseurs des animaux

en.title: "Petfluencing" attracts social media audiences, but concerns animal welfare advocates
en.summary: Social media accounts featuring animals garner hundreds of thousands of followers and generate substantial revenue. Animal protection organizations, however, express concern that certain staged content may harm animal welfare.

stories.title: «Ein SP-Wirtschaftsminister wäre für die Gewerkschaften nicht nur förderlich»: Jetzt zweifeln auch Linke an Bundesrat Jans

en.title: "An SP Economy Minister Would Not Only Be Beneficial for Trade Unions": Now the Left Also Doubts Federal Councillor Jans
en.summary: Following the resignation of Federal Councillor Guy Parmelin, Beat Jans could take over the economy department. However, several trade union representatives question whether the SP federal councillor is suitable for the position.

stories.title: Golfküste der USA – Sturm «Isaias» kein Hurrikan mehr – trotzdem Lebensgefahr

en.title: US Gulf Coast – Storm 'Isaias' no longer a hurricane – still poses life-threatening danger
en.summary: Storm Isaias weakened from hurricane status but caused a state of emergency across multiple southern US states upon arrival.

stories.title: Hurrikan «Isaias» trifft auf US-Golfküste: vier Tote und etliche ohne Strom durch

en.title: Hurricane 'Isaias' hits US Gulf Coast: four dead and many without power
en.summary: Storm Isaias caused deaths and widespread power outages across southern US states in a state of emergency, while Mexico prepared for the hurricane's arrival.

stories.title: Schweizer Super League: Lugano gewinnt souverän, auch Zürich und Servette spielen Heimsiege

en.title: Swiss Super League: Lugano wins convincingly, Zurich and Servette also secure home victories
en.summary: FC Zurich defeated Thun 4-2, Lugano beat Lucerne 4-0, and Servette won 3-0 against FC Sion in Super League matches.

stories.title: Proteste gegen Wahlkommission – Polizei in Indien nimmt Gründer der «Kakerlaken»-Bewegung fest

en.title: Protests against election commission – Indian police arrest founder of "Cockroach" movement
en.summary: The protest movement accuses the Modi government of corruption. Police have arrested the movement's founder amid escalating tensions over electoral concerns.

stories.title: 10. Runde der Super League – Servette lässt Sion im Rhone-Derby erneut keine Chance

en.title: 10th round of Super League – Servette gives Sion no chance in Rhone Derby again
en.summary: Servette dominated Sion 3-0 at home in the 10th round Rhone Derby of the Super League.

stories.title: LIVE-TICKER - Krieg in der Ukraine: Trump fordert Ablösung Selenskis +++ Sieben Tote nach russischen Angriffen in Saporischja

en.title: LIVE TICKER - War in Ukraine: Trump calls for Zelensky's replacement +++ Seven dead after Russian attacks in Zaporizhzhia
en.summary: Russia continues its war against Ukraine, now in its fifth year. Key developments include Trump's call for Zelensky's replacement and reports of seven deaths from Russian attacks on Zaporizhzhia.

stories.title: Zahlreiche Festnahmen bei Protesten in Delhi – auch der Gründer der «Kakerlaken»-Bewegung soll festgenommen worden sein

en.title: Numerous arrests during protests in Delhi – founder of "Cockroach" movement reportedly arrested
en.summary: More than 130 million names have disappeared from voter rolls, prompting the "Cockroach People's Party" to demand accountability and organize street protests.

stories.title: Krieg in der Ukraine – Ukraine: Mindestens 20 Tote nach Angriff auf Saporischja

en.title: War in Ukraine – Ukraine: At least 20 dead after attack on Zaporizhzhia
en.summary: At least 20 people died in an attack on Zaporizhzhia, including three minors, according to Ukrainian civil protection authorities.

stories.title: Die Sportkette Decathlon verhökert On-Schuhe zum Schleuderpreis, obwohl sie von On gar nicht beliefert wird

en.title: Sporting goods chain Decathlon sells On shoes at rock-bottom prices despite receiving no supply from On
en.summary: Decathlon and major retailers including Zalando are undercutting On's premium pricing strategy with steep discounts on On shoes, despite On not supplying these retailers directly.

stories.title: 45 Millionen Franken verschwunden: Schweizer Family-Offices verzocken sich mit Algorithmus-Sportwetten

en.title: 45 million francs missing: Swiss family offices lose money with algorithm sports betting
en.summary: Swiss family offices invested 45 million francs in algorithm-based sports betting following promises of high returns, but the money has disappeared. Investigators are tracking leads to a figure from Lake Constance and Turkish betting networks.

stories.title: Eine Gruppe will die überschuldeten Sportbahnen Braunwald übernehmen – und damit nicht nur den Skibetrieb retten

en.title: A group wants to take over the heavily indebted Braunwald cable cars – and thus rescue not only ski operations
en.summary: A coalition of holiday home owners and locals has made a purchase offer for the financially struggling Braunwald cable car operation, which plans to discontinue traditional skiing and close a major summer lift.

stories.title: GASTKOMMENTAR - Wenn Menschen es nicht wert sind, ersetzt zu werden – es gibt Fragen, auf die keine politische Partei eine Antwort weiss

en.title: GUEST COMMENTARY - When People Are Not Worth Replacing – There Are Questions to Which No Political Party Has an Answer
en.summary: Western concerns about immigration from the Global South and anxiety about artificial intelligence challenge political responses, as populist parties exploit some fears while traditional solutions fail against AI risks.

stories.title: Süsses Eis, bittere Zahlen: Warum Israels Wirtschaftsboom auf wackligen Füssen steht

en.title: Sweet ice, bitter numbers: Why Israel's economic boom stands on shaky ground
en.summary: Despite three years of exceptional conditions, Israel's economy appears resilient, but much of the reported growth is concentrated in a single dominant company.
